title: Squared mean at most mean of square on a finite probability space
statement:
Let $\Omega$ be a finite probability space, and let $f\colon\Omega\to\bbr$ be any real-valued function. Then the square of the expectation of $f$ is at most the expectation of its square:
\[
  \Bigl(\int_\Omega f\,\Bigr)^2 \;\le\; \int_\Omega f^2,
\]
where both integrals are taken with respect to the underlying probability measure.
replaced:
For a finite probability space $\Omega$ and any $f : \Omega \to \mathbb{R}$,
\[
  \Bigl(\int_\Omega f\Bigr)^2 \;\le\; \int_\Omega f^2.
\]
